name: Emoji Rating Slider
description: Gradient feedback card with a draggable thumb that snaps across five moods, morphing an emoji face, card colors and a watermark word, with a Save button.
contents: Card with large watermark rating word behind a morphing emoji face
Bottom bar with prompt text, current rating word and Save button
behavior: Dragging the thumb changes the rating live and snaps to the nearest of five points on release
Face mouth and eyes morph, card gradient and accent colors cross-fade
Face bounces when the rating changes
Save calls onSave with the rating name

props.name: ratings
props.default: 5 sample ratings: awful, bad, okay, good, great

editableByProps: Rating names and all per-rating colors
Prompt text, save label, save button visibility

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card size or track length

fixed: Exactly five ratings are supported, matching the five face shapes and snap points
Card is a fixed 320 by 288 pixel size
Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
